build_diffusion_transformer: build a DiffusionTransformer model with FiLM conditioning for audio to photoreal diffusion tasks
build_regression_transformer: build a RegressionTransformer encoder-decoder model with optional causal masking for sequence regression
create_causal_mask: create a causal attention mask tensor for transformer self-attention or cross-attention layers
create_film_decoder_layer: create a FiLMTransformerDecoderLayer with feature-wise linear modulation conditioned on timestep embeddings
create_rotary_encoder_layer: create a TransformerEncoderLayerRotary with rotary positional embeddings for self-attention
